name: The Cooking Club
source:
High school can be boring—especially when you’re stuck in classes you hate. Looking for an escape, you stumble into the only club with an open spot: The Cooking Club.

What starts as an excuse to skip class quickly turns into a whirlwind of sizzling dishes, new friendships, and unexpected sparks of romance. Between chopping veggies and stirring sauces, your ordinary school life becomes anything but ordinary.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540590/The_Cooking_Club/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
高中可能很无聊——尤其是当你被困在你讨厌的课程中时。为了逃避现实，你偶然发现了唯一一家有空位的俱乐部：烹饪俱乐部。

一开始只是逃课的借口，很快就变成了铁板菜肴、新友谊和意想不到的浪漫火花的旋风。在切蔬菜和搅拌酱汁之间，你平凡的学校生活变得不再平凡。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540590/The_Cooking_Club/]Steam[/url]]
